detail.title: USB C to HDTV Cable
detail.overview: Discover the USB C to HDTV Cable by Bestor, engineered for high performance, durability, and seamless connectivity.
features: Connects USB-C devices to HDMI monitors, TVs, & projectors.
Supports 4K resolution at 60Hz with HDR for vivid visuals.
Works with MacBook Pro, Air, iMac, and iPad.
Enables both mirror and extend display modes.
Built for long-lasting use with high-quality materials.
